name: CADS (cond annealed by noise)
plain: Adds noise to text conditioning early in sampling, decaying through a window, to widen variety, then renormalises to keep the original stats. Implemented at the cond-batch level so every model call gets it.
math:
γ = clamp((σ_s−σ)/(σ_s−σ_e),0,1), active only when σ ≤ σ_s.
y' = √γ·y + s·√(1−γ)·n; y' rescaled to mean, std of y.

props.architectures: Any model with the listed cond keys

label: from code

audit.note: cads_ppm.py:60 only runs when sigma <= sigma_start. Above it nothing is touched, but the math as written gives gamma=0 there, which reads as pure noise on the cond.
